item.ns2:title: A Tall Tale about Socks and Goblins
item.title: A Tall Tale about Socks and Goblins
item.ns2:summary: This is another replay because I'm on holiday with my family. I love this story. It may be one that appeals more to Mums. I like that it features both of my daughters. My older daughter always complains that she isn't mentioned as much in the tall tales as her younger sister. I love the sock fairy. It is one of my favourite ideas I've come up with for this series. item.title: "The Elves and the Shoemaker" as told by Nanny Piggins
item.ns2:summary: This is a replay of a story I wrote for the Adelaide Writer's Festival in 2021. I tried to record it live but it all went horribly wrong, so I recorded this in my hotel room that night. I'm very fond of this story. I do like coffee cake. Plus the Elves and the Shoemaker is a story my mother used to read to me when I was little.
